destination: v0.1.0 fully decided with all questions resolved and defaults challenged.

decisions.gist: Three generations of conventions upstream; old forms recognizable by headings and Status lines.
npm organization exists; unscoped npm name and Marketplace/Open VSX namespaces appear free.
One query returns whole map for 6 rate-limit points; relationships must be collected fresh each time.
Shell quoting and npm shims are Windows risks; running claude as terminal process avoids quoting issues.
Extension-host tests need Mocha through @vscode/test-cli; webview tested as Vue app outside VS Code.
VSCodium 1.135, Cursor 1.128, Windsurf 1.126; recommended floor ^1.105.0 set by extension host Node version.
On main and green in CI: Vite+ 1.0.0, Node 26.10, pnpm 12.8.1 and TypeScript 7 work together.
Publisher dbarjs chosen; extension ID dbarjs.hero-synergy; unscoped npm name and @hero-synergy packages stand.
Status hooks reliable with corrected table; plugin stays and hooks tool calls; PermissionRequest distinguishes questions from approvals.
@effect/vitest 4 works with Vitest 5 under Vite+ on Node 24 and 26 with no override needed.
GitHub on github.com with native relationships and local markdown only; GitLab and Other trackers cut for v0.1.0.
Only extension ships; CLI and Nitro cut; @hero-synergy/core stays private, bundled into extension, nothing to npm.
Effect Schema for all boundary data; zod dropped; one library sufficient for 25 KB gzipped in webview.
Every ticket session pushes its own edits straight to main after rebase; Cockpit never writes to tracker or repo.
VS Code ^1.105.0 on macOS and Linux; WSL as Windows route; no gating on editor or OS beyond stated requirements.
